name: Calm Face, Loud Brain
title: Unisex Nurse – Calm Face, Loud Brain Socks
story: Calm face, loud brain: nurse socks for the nurse who stays steady on the floor while her mind runs a full chart review, a stocking stuffer for the night-shift friend or the new grad, wrapped for Christmas or Nurses Week.

The print is a heart-rate line that stays steady, then turns into a red scribble, between CALM FACE. in black condensed capitals and LOUD BRAIN. in red, on cream. The art matches our Calm Face, Loud Brain crewneck and hoodie, so the socks make a set with the sweatshirt.

Nurses spend twelve hours on their feet and hold the rest together with a good poker face. These are the socks that say what the face does not, and they sit under scrubs without a word. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order, an easy gift for the nurse, nursing student or nurse mom who already owns three pairs of clogs.
joke_a: Every nurse knows the face that stays calm at the bedside while the brain is running ten tasks at once. The Calm Face, Loud Brain Socks from Graphic Tees Co. print that on the leg as a steady heart-rate line that turns into a scribble, so the joke reads at shift change and on the break room couch.
ink: the black, red and cream print
